rooms.name: Village Green
rooms.description: A bell hangs over a quiet gathering place. Paths lead toward a small forge, a tavern, and the northern woods.

rooms.name: Old Forge
rooms.description: A banked charcoal hearth warms the stone floor. Simple iron tools rest beside the anvil.

rooms.name: The Lantern Room
rooms.description: Wooden tables and a broad fireplace offer shelter to travelers. The village green lies east.

rooms.name: Woodland Path
rooms.description: Old pines shelter a narrow footpath. Birdsong carries over the mossy stones.

items.name: Oak walking staff
items.description: A plain staff worn smooth by years of travel.

items.name: Blacksmith's hammer
items.description: A practical iron hammer with an ash-wood handle.
